name: Website Ventures Higgsfield Manual Queue
source: WEBSITE-VENTURES-HQ-STATE.json + Website Ventures Production Line v3.3 + Agency Showroom Lab v1.5

status.activeGoal: Use the remaining Unlimited window only for visual gaps that directly improve Agency v1.5, its three example websites or one product/ad motion example.

hardRules: Joey generates manually on higgsfield.ai; ChatGPT does not spend connector generation credits automatically.
Every job must name the exact website/page slot before generation.
Quality and direct page usability outrank output count.
Review at realistic website size and inspect selected winners closely before upscaling.
Still/reference winner before expensive motion or 4K finish.
Generated UI must not replace real coded website UI; use real HTML/screenshots for interfaces.
Generated demos may never masquerade as real client projects, reviews, staff or measured results.
For Plumbing people, one recurring technician identity must be locked before working-scene variants.
Fire is optional only and never blocks progress.
At 50% remaining paid-generation balance, stop paid work and review before spending further credits.

currentDirections.agency: Product A: razor-thin black-glass/chrome tablet on one large rough pale stone, calm architectural space, restrained oxblood accent.
currentDirections.showcase01: Premium Plumbing: authentic Dutch trade credibility inside a very premium presentation.
currentDirections.showcase02: Architectural Luxury: calm cinematic renovation/editorial storytelling.
currentDirections.showcase03: Performance: energetic, darker, human/conversion-led world that must feel intentionally different from the first two.
currentDirections.productMotion: Clean premium product launch/motion language shown inside phone/social frames; no fake performance claim.

batches.name: Agency v1.5 · Product A finish inputs
batches.instruction: Only generate if the result can directly replace or materially improve the current Product-A hero/material treatment. Keep the same physical world and same object identity.

jobs.title: Product A hero refinement
jobs.purpose: Agency v1.5 opening hero material/reference master
jobs.count: 2-4 curated variants, then stop and review
jobs.prompt: Photoreal campaign frame for an elite web design studio. One razor-thin black-glass display tablet with precision chrome edge details rests naturally on one single large asymmetric rough pale limestone/travertine slab inside a calm bright architectural gallery. The stone must read as one substantial irregular rock, not a pile of spheres or small stones. Subtle deep oxblood-red accent only, controlled soft daylight, tactile micro-detail in stone, glass and metal, elegant negative space for large website typography, premium automotive-product photography polish without any car branding. No readable UI, no logos, no people, no extra devices, no clutter, widescreen 16:9.
jobs.gate: Pass only if the stone/device look materially more convincing than the coded blockout and can anchor the same-stone story.

jobs.title: Product A deliberate mobile derivative
jobs.model: Nano Banana 2 or current best reference-preserving image model
jobs.prompt: Recompose the supplied accepted Product A hero into a deliberate 4:5 mobile campaign frame. Preserve the exact same tablet, same single large pale stone, material palette and lighting language. Keep the device readable at a 390px viewport and preserve clean text-safe space. Recompose rather than crop. No new objects, no text, no logos, no people.
jobs.gate: Desktop and mobile must unmistakably be the same world and same object.

batches.name: Showcase 01 · Premium Plumbing
batches.instruction: Use one recurring technician identity only where a person actually strengthens the page. Generate a small coherent set, not a broad photo library.

jobs.title: Recurring technician lock
jobs.count: Up to 4 candidates; lock exactly one
jobs.prompt: Photoreal premium portrait of one experienced Dutch/European plumbing and installation technician, roughly 30-45, competent, calm and approachable. Authentic face, realistic skin and hands, natural posture, charcoal or deep navy technical workwear with one restrained oxblood accent, functional rather than fashionable. Bright believable modern service environment. Campaign-level polish but unmistakably a real tradesperson. No crossed arms, no stock-photo grin, no suit, no fashion-model styling, no text, no logo.
jobs.gate: Choose one identity only if he feels both credible to a Dutch homeowner and strong enough to carry a premium flagship.

jobs.title: Hero working scene
jobs.purpose: Premium Plumbing hero / major storytelling slot
jobs.prompt: Using the exact supplied technician identity, create a photoreal premium working scene in a bright modern Dutch bathroom. He is genuinely diagnosing or repairing a plumbing issue with realistic tools and natural body language. Preserve face, age, build, hair and workwear exactly. Campaign polish, believable trade work, clean copy-safe negative space, no second technician, no pose, no text, no logos, widescreen 16:9.
jobs.gate: Must be obviously the same technician and immediately usable in the actual Plumbing page.

jobs.title: Service detail scene
jobs.prompt: Using the exact supplied technician identity, show a close authentic service moment under a sink or at a visible installation detail in a clean Dutch home. Realistic hands, tools and plumbing hardware, controlled bright light, premium service-campaign composition and intentional negative space. Preserve the exact person and workwear. No second technician, no text, no logo.
jobs.gate: Only keep it if it fills a real page section not already covered by the hero.

batches.name: Showcase 02 · Architectural Luxury
batches.instruction: Create a calm architectural world with a distinct visual language from Plumbing; prioritize one hero and one transformation/detail asset.

jobs.title: Architectural renovation hero
jobs.prompt: Photoreal editorial hero for a premium renovation and interior craftsmanship website. One serene contemporary European bathroom/interior with sculptural natural stone, warm plaster, refined joinery and carefully controlled daylight. Architectural-magazine composition, quiet luxury, tactile surfaces, generous copy-safe negative space, sophisticated but believable rather than fantasy mansion. No people, no text, no logo, widescreen 16:9.
jobs.gate: Must feel calm, architectural and expensive enough to be clearly different from the Plumbing service world.

jobs.title: Cinematic transformation companion
jobs.count: 1-2 only after hero direction is selected
jobs.prompt: Create a second frame in the exact same architectural world and material palette as the supplied reference, designed for a cinematic renovation-story transition. Preserve room identity, lighting logic and key geometry while changing viewpoint/detail enough to reveal craftsmanship and transformation. No text, no logo, no people, widescreen 16:9.
jobs.gate: Must pair seamlessly with the hero in one scroll story rather than look like another random interior.

batches.name: Showcase 03 · Performance
batches.instruction: Make this unmistakably more energetic and human than the first two worlds. One strong hero is more valuable than a generic fitness photo pack.

jobs.title: Performance hero
jobs.prompt: Premium high-energy campaign hero for a performance coach or strength-training website. One authentic athlete in a focused training moment, sculptural directional light, deep graphite environment with one restrained electric or warm accent, crisp movement and strong negative space for short copy. Editorial sports-campaign quality, realistic skin and anatomy, confident but not aggressive, modern and clean. No gym-stock cliché, no exaggerated bodybuilding, no text, no logo, widescreen 16:9.
jobs.gate: Must feel instantly different from Plumbing and Architectural Luxury while still meeting the same premium quality ceiling.

jobs.title: Performance motion reference
jobs.model: Use current best reference-preserving video/motion model only after still winner
jobs.balance: Unlimited only if supported; otherwise defer
jobs.prompt: Preserve the exact athlete, environment and framing. Add only subtle premium movement: controlled body motion, fabric response, light sweep or atmospheric depth. Keep the subject stable and avoid morphing, camera chaos or ad-like text overlays.
jobs.gate: Keep only if motion clearly raises the perceived quality without identity drift.

batches.name: Product / ad motion · capability proof
batches.instruction: Build one excellent motion example rather than a large ad library. Treat it as an internal demo until a real product owner gives permission for a genuine case.

jobs.title: Premium product-launch still
jobs.purpose: Agency v1.5 'We also make things move' phone/product slot
jobs.model: Higgsfield Soul 2.0 or best product-image model available in Unlimited
jobs.prompt: Premium vertical product-launch campaign frame for a high-quality strength-training accessory such as a leather weightlifting belt. One beautifully constructed belt presented as an engineered object, tactile leather grain and metal hardware, refined studio architecture, warm neutral stone, deep charcoal and one restrained oxblood accent. High-end product photography, strong depth and copy-safe space, no brand logo, no readable text, no person, no fake performance claim, vertical 9:16.
jobs.gate: Must look like a real premium product campaign and work inside a phone/social frame.

jobs.title: Premium product motion
jobs.model: Seedance 2.5 or current best reference-preserving motion model
jobs.balance: Unlimited only if supported; otherwise defer
jobs.prompt: Preserve the exact supplied product, materials and set. Create a restrained luxury product motion: slow controlled camera arc and/or product rotation, subtle light travel across leather and hardware, natural shadows and precise material response. No product morphing, no extra straps or buckles, no text, no logo, no human hands, no sudden cuts. The result should feel like a premium launch film that can live inside a website or social phone frame.
jobs.gate: Keep only if object geometry remains stable and the motion is genuinely useful on the agency site.

finishGate.rule: Do not upscale or finish everything. Only winners actually destined for a live page earn final-resolution work.
steps: Check crop, anatomy, hands, material detail and consistency at realistic website size.
Only then create mobile derivative, motion or higher-resolution master if needed.
Commit file + metadata and promote through Selected Assets before calling it integrated.

history.note: Previous Batch 5-11 prompt history remains available through the archive/Git history. Old Fire Challenger is no longer mandatory.
